# Funnel (`funnel`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

Shows an ordered set of stages as bars: either drop-off from stage to stage, or how many items sit at each step right now.

**Use when:** A process with ordered stages: a fulfillment pipeline (ordered, awaiting receipt, received, shipped, invoiced), a sales pipeline, or any flow where stage-to-stage drop-off or the count waiting at each step matters.

**Don't use when:** The categories have no natural order (use bar_chart), they are parts of one whole with no flow (use donut), or the user needs the individual orders (use table).

**Sizes:** M (default), L, full

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"funnel"` | yes | Always "funnel". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"M"` \| `"L"` \| `"full"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: M, L, full. Default: `"M"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `stages` | list of object | yes | Stages in process order, first step first. |
| `stages[].label` | string | yes | Stage name, e.g. "Awaiting receipt". |
| `stages[].value` | number or null | yes | Raw count or amount for the stage. Use null when it is unknown, never 0. |
| `stages[].detail` | string |  | Optional short context for the stage, e.g. "Avg 4.2 days in stage". |
| `mode` | `"conversion"` \| `"snapshot"` |  | conversion: each stage counts everything that reached it, so it shows % of the previous stage and % of the first. snapshot: each stage counts what is sitting there right now, so it shows each stage's share of the total. Default: `"conversion"`. |
| `format` | `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` |  | How stage values are displayed. Use integer for counts of orders or lines, currency for dollar amounts. Default: `"integer"`. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "funnel",
  "id": "q3-fulfillment",
  "title": "Q3 2026 orders through fulfillment",
  "subtitle": "Orders placed Jul 1 to Sep 30, 2026",
  "size": "M",
  "mode": "conversion",
  "format": "integer",
  "stages": [
    { "label": "Ordered", "value": 1240 },
    { "label": "Received", "value": 1118, "detail": "Avg 6.1 days from order" },
    { "label": "Shipped", "value": 1062, "detail": "Avg 1.4 days from receipt" },
    { "label": "Invoiced", "value": 1049 }
  ]
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Error when two stages share a label.
- Warns when a stage in a conversion funnel is larger than the stage before it (the data is probably a snapshot: use mode "snapshot").
- Warns when every stage is null.
